entities.summary: Joseph Cooke Jr. was a professional basketball player. He played college basketball for the Indiana Hoosiers and played for the Cleveland Cavaliers during their inaugural 1970–71 season. In 73 games, he averaged 9.9 minutes and 4.3 points per game.
